title: A New $L2-1_σ$-Interior Penalty Method for Variable-Order Time-Fractional Subdiffusion Interface Problem with Curved Interface
summary: This paper treats variable-order time-fractional subdiffusion with discontinuous coefficients across a curved interface using $L2\!-\!1_σ$ time stepping on graded meshes and a symmetric interior penalty FEM on body-fitted meshes. Stability and optimal a priori error estimates in a discrete-in-time $L^2$ norm are established, yielding second-order temporal accuracy.
